label: RBv2
reply:
**1. Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system returned `pending_approval` for the settlement, so this status is accurate. No payment has been made. A human claims handler must approve it.

**2. Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: RBv2-CLM-06_r5. Policy VER-1004, policyholder Thomas Petit, Volkswagen Golf (2020), market value €15,500.
- Coverages in the Policy Schedule: C1 and C2. This claim is under C2 (damage to the insured's own car).
- Incident 8 October 2026. Reported 10 October 2026 (2 days).
- Rear-end collision with the car in front in a traffic jam. The customer admits fault.
- Mr. Blanc is named by surname only. He co-signed the accident report.
- Repair quote: €1,500.
- Documents received: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. Counted as provided; not opened.
- Licence held since 1 November 2008, so the young-driver surcharge does not apply.
- Place of the incident is **not stated** in the email.

**3. Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 collision damage is in the Policy Schedule, so Article 7.3 does not apply. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Reporting:** A claim must be reported within 5 days of the incident. It was reported in 2 days. No late-report referral under Article 7.1. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Required documents (C2):** photos, repair quote, and an accident report signed by both drivers when a third party is involved. All three were received. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Required claim details:** Article 4.2 also requires the date, the place, and a description of the incident. The date and description are present. The place is missing. This is not a document, so the system did not request it. A handler should confirm it. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Exclusions:** Nothing in the email suggests an Article 3 exclusion. Alcohol, licence, racing, intent, and wear are not mentioned. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Deductible:** One standard C2 deductible of €300 applies. The not-at-fault waiver does not apply because the customer is at fault. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1;2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Mr. Blanc:** He affects liability between the drivers. The claim is for the insured's own car, and the signed accident report requirement is met.
- **Assessor:** The rule applies only when the repair cost is above €1,500. The quote is exactly €1,500, so no assessor is required. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/>
- **Payment:** Compensation is repair cost minus deductible. Payment is made within 15 days after a Veridia claims handler approves it. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2;3" name="Veridia contract"/>

**Note on the subagent run:** the subagent said it could not read the contract and cited only the calculation output. I checked the contract myself, and the conclusions above match it.

**4. Amounts (from compute_settlement)**
- Repair quote: €1,500
- Deductible: €300
- Payout (pending approval): €1,200
- Assessor required: No

**5. Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Petit,
>
> Thank you for reporting the accident of 8 October 2026 under policy VER-1004 (claim reference RBv2-CLM-06_r5). We have received your repair quote, your photos and your signed accident report. Your claim has been passed to our claims team for final review, and we will contact you once a decision has been made. In the meantime, please keep all repair invoices and a copy of the accident report.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims

**Suggested handler action:** confirm the place of the incident with the customer before approving the €1,200 payment.
